units: <cite ref="Shabbat 150a:12">Sabb. 150ᵃ</cite> <he>מְשַׁדְּכִין על … ועל התינוק וכ׳</he> you may stipulate on the Sabbath about girls to be betrothed, and about a boy to be taught reading or a trade. Tosef. ib. XVI (XVII), 22 <he>ואין מְשַׁדְּכִין בין וכ׳</he> you must not negotiate business affairs between a husband and his wife (to reconcile them) on the Sabbath.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 44b:9">Kidd. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>והוא ששִׁדְּכוּ</he> provided they have been negotiating (with her father).
<cite ref="Kiddushin 44b:10">Ib.</cite> (mixed dict.) <he>אע״ג דשִׁידְּכוּ</he> even if they have been negotiating.

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2">Esth. R. s. 2</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 29:11">Prov. XXIX, 11</cite> <he>ישבחנה</he>) <he>זה הקב״ה שהוא מַשְׁדִּיךְ וכ׳</he> this refers to the Lord who quieted Ahasverus (ref. to <he>משביח</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 65:8">Ps. LXV, 8</cite>).
